text: Added exact native AtlasRealization foundations in 5405090: volume realizations now admit a live image4s GridDomain plus one locus4s PartialSurjection retained by VolumeParcellation; surface realizations use one bilateral PartialSurjection; persistent parcel identity, certified retargeting, hierarchy, and Neuropublish projection are derived. Full atlas suites pass JVM 81/81 and JS 53/53. Next: make VolumeAtlas and SurfaceAtlas store these realizations and migrate consumers before removing legacy AtlasQuotient/Clustered owners.
